# AudioPlayerElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement.h"`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement> CreateAudioPlayer( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement> CreateAudioPlayerFromFile( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h, const std::string& filePath);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement> CreateCompactAudioPlayer( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasAudioPlayerElement(const std::string& identifier = "AudioPlayer", long x = 0, long y = 0, long w = 400, long h = 56);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPlay` | `std::function<void()> onPlay` | _Play_ |
| `onPause` | `std::function<void()> onPause` | _Pause_ |
| `onStop` | `std::function<void()> onStop` | _Stop_ |
| `onSeek` | `std::function<void(double)> onSeek` | _Seek_ |
| `onEnded` | `std::function<void()> onEnded` | _Ended_ |
| `onFileOpened` | `std::function<void(const std::string& filePath)> onFileOpened` | _File opened_ |
| `onOpenCancelled` | `std::function<void()> onOpenCancelled` | _Open cancelled_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `Unload` | `void Unload()` | Lets go of the loaded track: playback stops and the decoded audio is released along with the file it came from, which is what frees it for renaming, replacing or deleting. Stop() only rewinds. The element stays usable: a later LoadFromFile loads again. |

| `Render` | `void Render(IRenderContext* ctx, const Rect2Df& dirtyRect) override` | Render paints the background panel, then the container renders the child widgets. Events are routed to the children by UltraCanvasContainer, so no OnEvent override / manual hit-testing is needed. |
| `Arrange` | `void Arrange(const Rect2Df& finalRect, const CSSLayout::LayoutContext& ctx) override` | Post-layout hook: hides the volume slider (then the time label) when the arranged width cannot fit them beside a usable seek bar, so narrow hosts (e.g. the UltraFiler preview pane) don't clip controls at the right edge. |
